items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I played it with him many times before.

ctx.x: I should explain to our listeners eventually, that I got to see you play last night with the Marian McPartland tribute which was a wonderful event. And when Sweets Edison came out, and I think you did a couple of numbers and then you were going to do “Centerpiece,” and Marian was at the other piano. And I saw you do this to her, you know? It was very deliberate that you were showing her something. Can you explain what that’s about?

Yeah, let me explain. Marian was actually joking, she said well “Centerpiece,” that’s one of the tunes that we played, that’s the tune that we played when Marian came out. It’s a Sweets’ original. Sweets Edison original. I played it with him many times before. Anybody knows it’s in the key of A flat. So Marian was just joking, she said, “What © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
key?” And so I said [gestures] which means four flats, key of A flat. So we were just joking back and forth and having some fun.
